title: introduce-econ-advisor-hybrid-prefill-and-quant-profile-selector
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds an automated cost advisor that synthesizes hybrid prefill heuristics and quantization profile selection based on workload samples. Backwards-compatible: disabled by default and gated behind feature flags and canary rollout.
description: Context: Customers frequently ask for safe, automated defaults to reduce per-token cost without regressing latency or accuracy. Existing heuristics (separate prefill and quant suggestion flows) required manual tuning and had limited visibility into unit economics across workloads. Motivation: Provide a single lightweight service (econ-advisor) that analyzes short workload samples, recommends a hybrid prefill strategy (mix of prefix-prefill and opportunistic microbatching) and a set of candidate quantization profiles with estimated unit-econ impact and a safety score. What this PR does (summary): 1) Introduces services/econ_advisor: analysis pipeline, candidate generator, safety evaluator and a lightweight REST endpoint used by the console and the runtime. 2) Adds runtime hooks in serving/batcher to accept advisory hints: suggested prefill ratios, preferred microbatch size, and quant profile id. 3) Adds quant-profile catalog integration and a cost-estimator module that emits per-request estimated delta cost and expected latency variance. 4) Adds observability: new metrics (econ.advisor.safety_score, econ.advisor.estimated_pct_cost_change, econ.advisor.recommendation_source), tracing spans and a small dashboard template. 5) Adds unit and integration tests and a canary rollout plan (feature flag + canary by tenant). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-7123) - [x] Backend implementation of advisor pipeline - [x] Runtime hook and backward-compatible opt-in - [x] Unit tests for advisor sampling and safety evaluator - [x] Integration tests against a synthetic workload sampler - [x] Console integration (read-only recommendation endpoint) - [x] Basic dashboard panels and alerts - [x] Canary rollout config and migration notes - [x] Documentation snippets + quickstart example How to exercise locally: run services/econ_advisor locally (scripts/start_econ_advisor.sh) and use postman to POST sampled workload payloads to /v1/recommend. The runtime has an env flag REDWOOD_ECON_ADVISOR_URL to point to a local instance for canary testing. Migration/compatibility notes: All runtime changes are opt-in and default to existing behavior. The quant-profile registry is read-only by default; advisor outputs are suggestions stored in a tenant-scoped recommendations table. We included a dry-run mode that emits metrics but doesn't apply changes. Commits included below and a short list of changed files. CI: initial lint failure (unused import in serving/batcher) fixed in follow-up commit. All tests (unit+integration) are green on the final run. Merge: squashed and merged to main after 1 approval and one request-for-changes addressed.

summary: Adds an automated econ-advisor service that recommends hybrid prefill and quant profiles with safety scoring and telemetry. Opt-in canary rollout, no default behavior changes.
notes_for_release: Feature: econ-advisor (opt-in). Admins can enable via feature flag. See docs/quickstarts/econ-advisor.md for examples and canary steps.
risk_assessment: Low to medium. Advisor only provides suggestions; no automatic changes unless tenant explicitly enables apply-mode. Safety evaluator tested against synthetic workloads with conservative thresholds by default.
qa_steps: 1) Start advisor locally: scripts/start_econ_advisor.sh 2) POST sample workloads to /v1/recommend and verify response fields: recommendations, safety_score, estimated_pct_cost_change 3) Point serving runtime to advisor and run synthetic traffic; assert metrics econ.advisor.* emitted and no behavioral change unless apply-mode is enabled
deployment_instructions: Canary plan: enable feature flag for 5% of tenants for 72 hours, monitor econ.advisor.safety_score and request-error-rate. If safety_score < 0.7 for >10% of requests, rollback flag. Full rollout requires sign-off from SRE and Product.
time_estimate_to_revert: < 30m - flip feature flag and restart batcher workers
additional_context: This PR is the first step towards converging quant profile selection and prefill heuristics into a single advisory surface. Follow-ups planned: automated A/B reporting for cost vs quality and a lightweight optimizer that suggests tenant-specific rollout schedules.
